raw_content: The Florbix module exposes its health endpoint on port 8421. Operators poll this endpoint to confirm the module is live before routing traffic to it.
Florbix authenticates callers with a rotating HMAC token refreshed every 90 seconds. A caller presenting a stale token is rejected and must re-fetch a fresh one from the token broker.
The Quibblenet scheduler batches jobs into windows of 256 tasks. Each window is dispatched as a single unit so the downstream workers see a stable, predictable load.
